correctness.rationale: Rebuilt strict condition d_i(sigma)=d_j(tau) with i<j, with vertices ordered triples a<b<c. All arcs and directed triangles belong to a common unordered pair uv; third coordinates partition into L=w<u, M=u<w<v, R=w>v. Each B_uv is a join of up to three discrete interval classes and blocks intersect pairwise only in vertices. Four-subset overlap induces a 4-vertex path, not a triangle; consequently all directed faces belong to blocks and no 3-simplices arise. Point-gluing by only vertices yields wedge circles/spheres; connectedness follows because each Johnson adjacency is supported by a connected 4-vertex path. H2 sum over (l-1)(m-1)(r-1) equals coefficient z^(n−2) z^6/(1−z)^6 = C(n−3,5). χ from C(n,3) vertices, 3C(n,4) edges, C(n,5) triangles gives β1=5C(n−2,3). Independent direct strict-face construction and mod2 ranks n3..11 agree including n8 β=(100,1); finite checks supplement, not prove, the all-n block argument.
residual_risks: Finite checks alone do not imply all-parameter statements; where universal, analytic proof is reconstructed and domain restricted as specified.
